Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING CORE BODY three-view character-model design sheet, landscape 3:2 canvas, clean light warm-white background.
Input image 1 = APPROVED King's CORE BODY reference, authority for all BODY armor, colors, proportions and identity below the neck. Image 2 = latest APPROVED NORMAL HEAD with crimson sagittal dorsal fin, authority for head/horns and normal face. These are reference images for a NEW turnaround sheet, not permission to redesign.
Draw exactly THREE complete full-body orthographic-style views of this SAME robot, ordered FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR, in separate evenly spaced columns. Same body scale and common floor line, matching skull, shoulder, hip, knee and ankle heights across views. Standing naturally upright, feet shoulder-width, arms relaxed slightly away from torso with a small elbow bend, same physical pose seen from three sides. No perspective foreshortening, no 3/4 view, no action pose. Frame complete horn tips, both hands and full soles with outer margins.
King identity: navy blue torso and armor, ivory limbs, crimson abdomen/panels and chin, gold outlines and circular joints. Large navy shoulder plates with ivory/gold edging and red outer recesses; paired gold rectangular CHEST LOUVRES and the central golden champion crest belong on the FRONT ONLY; navy back armor with a simple central spine, two discreet empty backpack attachment sockets and gold-edged structural plating, no invented giant backpack. Strong heavy forearms, both normal dark articulated hands, long ivory thighs, ivory knee/shin planes with navy side panels and gold accents, broad navy boots with gold toe caps and red/gold ankle circles. Preserve the exact reference body's anatomical proportions and long-legged hero presence; don't make it squat or stretch only the shins. Rear knees/heel joints reveal coherent simple dark mechanics and gold socket rims, not a copy of front kneecaps or chest.
Use the APPROVED NORMAL FACE in every visible face view: separate pale eyes, navy nose, broad ivory lower face with subtle mouth line, crimson chin latch, gold cheek frames and circular gold ear housings. Head shell must keep its tall normal volume. Exactly FIVE gold crown pieces: one thick center horn smoothly curving forward and UP, tiny backward notch; two long inner slim fins, two shorter outer fins. Add the SAME single thin crimson MIDLINE fore-aft dorsal fin behind the gold crown: broad red triangular face in left PROFILE, completely hidden by the taller front gold horn in FRONT, narrow red EDGE only at REAR. No broad red triangle in rear/front, no second red fin. Rear view cannot show a face or mouthplate. Crown roots remain frontal/temporal, no extra gold spikes.
This is the UNARMORED CORE VARIANT: no wings, no shoulder cannons, no drill or shield, no missile pods, no auxiliary booster nacelles. Both hands remain present.
Style: clean crisp Japanese cel robot design, controlled line hierarchy, broad clear panels and hard two-tone shadows, same drawing language as references. Add only thin faint horizontal registration lines behind the three figures. No labels, no lettering, no logos other than the existing chest emblem, no text, no arrows, no cropped figures, no new weapons.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING HEAD six-view detail sheet for two face states, clean light warm-white background, landscape 3:2 canvas.
Input image 1 = APPROVED NORMAL FACE with red midline helmet fin. Image 2 = APPROVED BATTLE MASK with exactly the SAME helmet and fin. Use these exact designs without redesigning the crown, skull or face.
Draw SIX equally sized head-and-short-neck views in TWO ROWS of THREE. Top row: NORMAL face FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Bottom row: BATTLE MASK FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Identical skull size, height, eye-line, neck baseline, crown root positions and viewing angles. The two REAR views must be IDENTICAL HELMET DESIGN because closing a mouthplate doesn't change the helmet back. Match complete horn tips and collars with generous spacing, no 3/4 views, no perspective.
Copy approved head identity: navy faceted dome with normal tall shell volume, separate pale warm eyes beneath black brow, navy nose, ivory angular lower face and heavy jaw, red chin, gold cheek vent frames and round gold ear housings.
Copy crown topology, not a similar generic crown: exactly FIVE gold pieces, central thick-rooted forward/up curved blade horn with tiny backward notch, paired long inner slim gold fins, paired shorter outer gold fins. Front projection is exactly symmetric and centered, side projection shows the curve in the forward/up plane. No flattening skull or inventing extra fins.
CRIMSON DORSAL FIN: exactly one thin vertical plate on the helmet sagittal midline, behind the forehead crown, a streamlined red triangular side face with rearward peak matching both references. FRONT: entirely occluded by the higher, broader central gold horn. LEFT PROFILE: broad crimson triangle seated along the navy dome as in references. REAR: fin is EDGE-ON so only a narrow red midline strip is visible, not a broad triangular red sail or twin crests. Keep the same fin size and pose in both rows.
Top normal face = visible navy nose, ivory mouth/jaw with subtle mouth line. Bottom battle face = the EXACT approved pair of broad ivory faceted armor halves closing over nose/mouth, central vertical seam/ridge, navy inset side vents, thin gold/blue framing, small red chin latch exposed. Eyes, brow, cheek frames, ear housings and helmet don't change.
Rear shell is a simple navy faceted armored back-of-head with subtle central panel seams and coherent ear backs; NO face or mouthplate drawn on rear. Keep gold fin direction and roots consistent rather than mirroring the entire face onto rear.
Clean cel linework, broad armor planes, hard two-tone shadows, matching source style. Thin faint horizontal eye-line/collar registration guides optional. No titles, no letters, no captions, no arrows, no new body, no shoulder gear.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the CORE BODY turnaround edit target. Image 2 is the authoritative HEAD turnaround sheet. Fix ONLY THE HEAD in Image 1's RIGHTMOST REAR full-body figure. Leave all other pixels/designs/poses/body armor and the other two figures unchanged.
The rear core head currently omits the central GOLD horn, showing just four side gold fins and the red fin. Correct it to the same FIVE-GOLD crown topology as Image 2's top-right rear head: two long inner gold fins, two short outer gold fins, and ONE GOLD CENTRAL HORN visible ABOVE/BEHIND the shorter narrow RED dorsal-fin edge. The red thin center edge cannot replace the taller gold center horn. Match center gold tip height to front view's tip height. Copy the rear navy faceted shell and central panel seam from the correct rear head in Image 2; remove the spurious big gold block under the red fin on the back of head if inconsistent. Keep both gold ear housings, neck attachment, head size, shoulder positions and guide lines unchanged. Do NOT draw a face on the rear. Do NOT change torso backpack sockets, rear skirt, arms or legs. No extra gold or red horns. Preserve the light background and original full three-view composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING FULL EQUIPMENT complete three-view design sheet. Very wide landscape about 3:1, clean light warm-white background.
Input 1 = APPROVED full-equipped King's body/equipment identity. Input 2 = the matching CORE turnaround, proportion/pose reference BELOW the neck ONLY; its rear crown is not authority. Input 3 = APPROVED battle-mask head with crimson dorsal fin. Input 4 = head turnaround authority for helmet front/side/rear.
Make exactly THREE complete full-body orthographic-style views of the SAME fully equipped King: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Allocate wider space to front and rear wing spans, narrower middle profile. Same body scale and common floor line across all three. Use the same underlying skull/shoulder/hip/knee/ankle heights and proportions as core Input 2. Standing upright, legs shoulder-width, upper arms slightly away from torso, both elbows bent about 20 degrees so forearms angle slightly FORWARD/DOWN. Same physical pose across views. Complete horn tips, wings, drill tip, shield tip and both boots visible; no overlaps between columns and no cropping. No 3/4, no perspective, no action pose.
Retain heavy navy/ivory/crimson/gold King, paired gold CHEST louvres and central champion emblem, layered shoulders, existing waist/leg armor and broad gold-toed navy boots. Those chest front features do NOT appear on the back. Head is the approved BATTLE MASK state with ONE thin crimson sagittal dorsal fin, FIVE gold crown members including central upward-curving horn and four paired side fins. FRONT red fin hidden behind taller gold middle horn; PROFILE shows broad crimson triangle; REAR shows a thin red center edge AND the taller gold central horn beyond it. Don't omit the center gold horn, flatten the head or remove the mask.
EXACT equipment inventory and handedness:
- ONE big gold helical drill over the robot's ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm, aimed down and slightly forward. FRONT = drill screen-LEFT. REAR = same drill screen-RIGHT. LEFT PROFILE = it belongs to the FAR arm, partly occluded by body/near shield; any visible tip still points down/forward toward screen-left. Never duplicate drills or change arms.
- ONE long ivory/navy/gold champion shield on ANATOMICAL LEFT forearm. FRONT = screen-RIGHT with the existing red lozenge and gold crest on OUTER face. REAR = screen-LEFT, show NAVY INNER surface with dark mounting brackets/straps and gold coupling, NO gold crest or front decorative red stripe copied to the inner face. LEFT PROFILE = near shield seen mostly edge-on, held in front of near left forearm; it must not become another chest/wing.
- Exactly TWO big rectangular shoulder/back cannons, parallel to body forward direction above shoulders, same round gold elevation pivots and navy/ivory casing. FRONT shows two BLACK RECTANGULAR MUZZLES. REAR shows TWO CLOSED ARMORED BREECHES/connection housings, NOT forward muzzle holes. PROFILE tubes point horizontally toward screen-left; near and far guns may occlude, do not invent extra cannons.
- ONE bilateral multilayer wing fan on rear wing spars, retaining the approved navy/ivory/gold surfaces and long red-tipped upper blades plus shorter lower fins. Keep the SAME physical blade inventory, blade lengths, hinge roots and layering across views; foreshortening/occlusion may hide a blade but never add a new wing on the chest. The FRONT wings project to either side behind shoulders; REAR shows the same fan roots, cross-support and backs of the SAME blades. PROFILE fans are compressed edge-on behind the back.
- Paired wing-root cylindrical booster clusters and exactly TWO long lower-back booster nacelles, one at each side, slanting down/out to lower-calf height, blue/ivory/gold shell and red end vent per approved source. Not extra legs, shields or rifles.
- Exactly FOUR leg missile pods: one on OUTER each thigh and one on OUTER each calf. Each has an ivory-edged dark face with exactly TWO circular launch apertures matching approved whole-body Input 1. Do NOT take a third aperture from any older parts sheet. Front-facing apertures stay on the pod FRONT; rear shows closed rear armor and attachment rails. Rear has two pods on each side of the body, not extra copies on inner legs.
Backpack: coherent central navy load-bearing spine between the two cannon trunnions, separate wing struts and lower booster mounts; show how approved equipment connects without inventing another backpack, third gun or fifth pod. Core body remains visible between gear.
Style: same clean cel robot design, controlled line hierarchy, broad armor planes and hard two-tone shadows. Faint horizontal registration lines only. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, title bars, extra figures or redesign.

3) ALL FOUR FRONT LEG MISSILE PODS currently have THREE black circular apertures; they must each have exactly TWO circular apertures matching the approved whole-body design. Keep each pod's external contour, mount, height, width, ivory border and position unchanged; adjust only its inset front face to two evenly spaced circles. Everything else MUST remain the same, especially anatomical RIGHT drill = front screen-left / rear screen-right; LEFT shield = front decorated outside / rear navy mounting inside; exactly two guns with FRONT muzzle holes and REAR armored breeches; existing wing fans and two low boosters. Crown, skull and facial volumes stay normally tall; do not achieve height by shrinking or flattening the head. Main body below the neck has a visibly narrow waist, long exposed ivory THIGHS as well as long shins, and strong boots. Do not let skirt armor swallow the thighs. Excluding crown horns, skull-top to soles should read about 8 to 8.5 normal head heights. Hip-axis to floor is roughly 58-60 percent of skull-top-to-floor.
